signature.name: VTask.prod
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> [Semiring R] -> {M : Type u_2} -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [Module R M] -> {N : Type u_3} -> [AddCommMonoid N] -> [Module R N] -> {P : Type u_4} -> [AddCommMonoid P] -> [Module R P] -> {ι : Type u_7} -> (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) -> (g : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] P) -> M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] (N × P)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This definition is a total constructor over all valid pairs of alternating maps sharing the same source, scalar ring, and index type; no junk-value or boundary conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] {ι : Type*} (f₁ f₂ : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) (g : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] P), VTask.prod (f₁ + f₂) g = VTask.prod f₁ g + VTask.prod f₂ g

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] {ι : Type*} (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) (g₁ g₂ : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] P), VTask.prod f (g₁ + g₂) = VTask.prod f g₁ + VTask.prod f g₂

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] {ι : Type*} (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) (g : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] P) (v : ι → M) (i j : ι), i ≠ j → v i = v j → VTask.prod f g v = 0

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] {ι : Type*} (r : R) (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) (g : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] P), VTask.prod (r • f) g = r • VTask.prod f g

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P] {ι : Type*} (f₁ f₂ : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N) (g₁ g₂ : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] P), VTask.prod f₁ g₁ = VTask.prod f₂ g₂ ↔ f₁ = f₂ ∧ g₁ = g₂
